contributorNote: Gĩkũyũ (Kikuyu) vocabulary compiled from Lieut. Ludwig von Höhnel (1894 "Discovery of Lakes Rudolf and Stefanie"), Sir Harry H. Johnston (1902, 1919), Rev. Fr. A. Hémery, C.S.Sp. (1903 "English-Kikuyu Hand-Book", Zanzibar—Nairobi: Roman Catholic Mission, pp. 1–87 [PDF pp. 1–92]), Hildegarde Hinde (1904), Rev. A. W. McGregor (1904 "English-Kikuyu Vocabulary", C.M.S. / SPCK London, Fort Smith / Kabeti 1901–1902, pp. i–iv, 5–192 [PDF pp. 1–201]), W. Scoresby & Katherine Routledge (1910), C. W. Hobley (1910, 1922), Hon. Charles Dundas (1915), and BFBS (1921). Expanded and cross-verified with Commercially Permissive Datasets (The Thiomi Dataset (CC-BY-4.0), Google SMOL/GATITOS (en_kik, CC-BY-4.0), African Next Voices Kenya (5 Gikuyu dialects, CC-BY-4.0), CGIAR Kikuyu–English (Apache-2.0), LughaGen (CC-BY-SA-4.0), Mich-Seth Owusu Emotion & Parallel Corpora (MIT/CC-BY-4.0), CLDF Tsammalex & ASJP v20 (CC-BY-4.0), Kaikki.org (CC-BY-SA-4.0)).

Kaikki.org / Wiktextract Kikuyu Dictionary (https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Kikuyu/index.html, CC-BY-SA-4.0)

entries.english: Planting certified seeds increases the maize harvest
entries.translation: Kũhanda mbegu njega nĩ kũongerera magetha ma mbembe
entries.pronunciation: koo-hah-ndah mbeh-goo nyeh-gah nee koo-oh-ngeh-reh-rah mah-geh-thah
entries.context: CGIAR Kikuyu-English Agricultural Translation Dataset (Vineet Singh 2024, Apache-2.0)

entries.english: Modern farming helps farmers protect soil and crops
entries.translation: Ũrĩmi wa mahinda maya nĩ ũteithagia arĩmi kũgitĩra tĩĩri na mĩmera yao
entries.context: The Thiomi Dataset & thiomi-5k Kikuyu (Mutisya, Mugane et al. 2026, CC-BY-4.0)

entries.english: Now you can send market payments via mobile phone from the farm
entries.translation: Rĩu no ũtũme mbeca cia thoko kũgerera thimũ mũgũnda-inĩ
entries.pronunciation: ree-oo noh oo-too-meh mbeh-shah shyah thoh-koh
entries.context: African Next Voices Kenya Kikuyu (Anv-ke/kikuyu, CC-BY-4.0)

entries.english: Peace and harmony are the foundation of national progress
entries.translation: Thayũ na ũiguano nĩ mũthingi wa ũkũri wa bũrũri witũ
entries.context: Leipzig Gikuyu CURL Web Corpus & Tonative XNLI Kikuyu (CC-BY-4.0)

entries.english: I feel peaceful and hopeful when my family is healthy
entries.translation: Nĩnjiguaga thayũ na mwĩhoko rĩrĩa famĩlĩ yakwa ĩrĩ na ũgima mwega wa mwĩrĩ
entries.context: Kikuyu Emotions Corpus (michsethowusu/kikuyu-emotions-corpus, 34,696 rows, MIT)

entries.english: Do not be anxious; every challenge has a wise solution
entries.translation: Ndũkareke ngoro yaku ĩtangĩke; o thĩna wĩ na kĩhonia kĩũgĩ
entries.context: Kikuyu Emotions Corpus (michsethowusu/kikuyu-emotions-corpus, MIT) & Tonative XNLI
